entries.title: Opening hours
entries.content: The clinic is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00 and Saturday from 09:00 to 13:00. It is closed on Sundays and public holidays.

entries.title: Location and transport
entries.content: The fictional demo clinic is at Demo Street 24, 10115 Berlin. The nearest station is Hauptbahnhof, about a 7-minute walk away. No real clinic exists at this demo address.

entries.title: New patient appointment
entries.content: New patients can request an appointment through the website form or by calling the fictional reception number +49 30 000000. The chatbot does not confirm appointments; reception must confirm the date and time.

entries.title: Routine examination
entries.content: A routine examination usually takes 30 minutes. It may include a discussion of concerns, an oral examination and, only when clinically indicated, an X-ray. Final treatment advice is given by a dentist.

entries.title: Professional cleaning
entries.content: Professional dental cleaning is offered and usually takes 45 to 60 minutes. The demo price is EUR 95 to EUR 140 depending on the time required. Reception can provide a non-binding estimate.

entries.title: Teeth whitening
entries.content: In-clinic whitening is available after a suitability check by a dentist. The fictional demo price starts at EUR 320. Whitening is not performed during pregnancy and may be unsuitable for untreated cavities or gum disease.

entries.title: Insurance and payment
entries.content: The clinic accepts public and private German health insurance. Coverage depends on the insurer and treatment. Card and cash payments are accepted. Patients should ask reception or their insurer for a binding coverage decision.

entries.title: Cancellation policy
entries.content: Appointments should be cancelled or rescheduled at least 24 hours in advance. A fictional demo late-cancellation fee of EUR 50 may apply. Reception reviews exceptions individually.

entries.title: Dental emergencies
entries.content: For severe swelling, uncontrolled bleeding, facial trauma, difficulty breathing or a life-threatening situation, call emergency services at 112. For urgent dental pain during opening hours, contact reception. The chatbot cannot diagnose or provide emergency treatment.

entries.title: Children and accessibility
entries.content: Children are welcome from age three. A parent or legal guardian must attend appointments for minors. The fictional clinic entrance and treatment rooms are wheelchair accessible; patients can tell reception about assistance needs.
